name: Shalemaw Burrower
summary: A blind, flat-snouted digger that chews through solid shale and bursts up under whatever it hears walking.
description: Shalemaws eat the soft seams in mountain rock and the grubs that live there, leaving tunnels that miners are glad to borrow and sorry to meet the owner of. A floor that hums faintly underfoot is the only warning anyone gets.

traits.name: Rock Tunneler
traits.text: The burrower can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed and leaves a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

traits.name: Erupt
traits.text: If the burrower moves out of the ground into a space within 5 feet of a creature, that creature must succeed on a {dc:str} Dexterity saving throw or have the {ref:condition/prone} condition. The burrower has {ref:glossary/advantage} on the next attack roll it makes against that creature this turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The burrower makes two Claw attacks.
